description: Proud to have attended the Ulster County EMS Recognition and Awards Dinner last night during EMS Week to honor the men and women who are the backbone of our community. When our neighbors face their hardest moments, EMS is there, answering the call with steady hands and selfless hearts. Congratulations to all of the honorees and thank you to every EMS professional across Ulster County for your service, sacrifice, and heart.
